title: Trump’s Crypto Corruption Is Off The Charts — Mehdi and Ben McKenzie Explore Why
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Back in April, **Mehdi** was joined on 'We're Not Kidding' by actor, author,
and now documentary filmmaker **Ben McKenzie** to talk about Ben's new film
which investigates the fraudulent and predatory cryptocurrency industry,
'[Everyone Is Lying to You For Money](https://www.everyoneislying.com/)'.

The documentary is finally available to stream online, but _for a limited time
only_ from Aug. 22 - Sept. 6. You can click the button below to stream
'Everyone Is Lying to You For Money' now.

[Stream the
Documentary](https://watch.eventive.org/everyoneislying/play/6a271e610f1d5fef3b4b09d5)

You can also revisit Mehdi's
[conversation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gaV1x7s1MpQ&t=1118s) with Ben
from earlier this year. They unpack the documentary's globetrotting story --
from Miami, to El Salvador, to London -- as Ben follows the (figurative)
money, including his now famous
[interview](https://www.instagram.com/p/DXo1BS1EhiW/) with convicted crypto
grifter Sam Bankman-Fried. Ben also explains what exactly cryptocurrency is
and uncovers why its evangelists want you to buy it so badly.

They also dig into the crypto industry's influence on both the Republican and
Democratic party, why the Trump family is the perfect avatar for crypto
fraudsters, and end up having a blunt conversation about the direction of the
Democratic Party. **" If you're a Democrat and you're having a hard time
choosing between people and corporations, my humble suggestion is to get the
fuck out of the party," **Ben says.
